data.name: Accelerate/Decelerate
data.description:
Accelerate. Target takes an extra 2d6 of the triggering attack's damage type.

Decelerate. Reduce the damage by 2d6 (min 0).
data.casting_time: 1 Reaction (when you see an attack roll hit a creature within 60 ft)
data.higher_levels: +1d6 to the effect per slot above 1st.

data.name: Acid Rain
data.description: 20-ft-radius, 60-ft-tall cylinder. On appearance, DEX save, 4d6 acid (half on success). Repeats when a creature enters the area first time on its turn or ends its turn there.
data.higher_levels: +1d6 acid per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Alustriel's Mooncloak
data.description:
20-ft Emanation of Dim Light moves with you; you and allies have Half Cover and resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Radiant. Once, ending the spell:

Liberation. When you fail a save to avoid/end Frightened, Grappled, or Restrained, take a Reaction to succeed instead.

Respite (Magic action). You or an ally in the area regains 4d10 + spellcasting mod HP.

data.name: Arcane Aegis
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Arcanomagnetic Field
data.description:
Attacks using ferrous weapons/ammunition against you have disadvantage. Area within 20 ft is difficult terrain for creatures made of ferrous metal or wearing ferrous armour.

Magnetic Pulse. On cast and as a bonus action on later turns, force one Huge or smaller creature in the difficult terrain to make a STR save or take 1d6 force damage and be knocked prone.
data.higher_levels: Radius +5 ft and damage +1d6 per slot above 2nd.

data.name: Arcanomagnetic Storm
data.description: A storm of up to ten 10-ft cubes (each adjacent to another). As a bonus action each turn, remove one cube and place another. Creatures starting their turn in / entering the area: DEX save, 4d8 lightning (half on success). Creatures ending their turn in the area: STR save, 4d8 force + knocked prone (half, no prone on success); ferrous creatures have disadvantage. Area is difficult terrain for ferrous creatures.
data.higher_levels: Both damages +1d8 per slot above 7th.

data.name: Assisted Aim
data.description: Up to three creatures gain +1 to ranged weapon attack rolls; their ranged weapons' normal/long ranges double for the duration.
data.higher_levels: One additional creature per slot above 1st.

data.name: Aundair's Silent Sphere
data.description: 5-ft Emanation muffles sound both directions: creatures outside have disadvantage on Perception to hear inside, and vice versa. Creatures have advantage on saves vs effects requiring them to hear a sound from across the Emanation (e.g. Command).

data.name: Aura of Impurity
data.description: 30-ft aura moves with you. Each chosen creature entering first time on its turn or starting its turn there makes a CHA save or becomes drained until end of next turn: roll d4 and subtract from each ability check, attack roll, or save; HP regained is halved.

data.name: Backlash
data.description: Reduce the triggering damage by 4d6 + spellcasting mod. If the source is a creature in range, force a CON save: 4d6 force (half on success).
data.higher_levels: Both reduction and force damage +1d6 per slot above 4th.

data.name: Binding Pledge
data.description: A willing creature makes a promise/oath/contract. You immediately know if it's broken; if so, you know its distance/direction for the rest of the duration. If dispelled, you know that but not the location.
data.higher_levels: Duration 30 days (3rd–4th slot), 1 year (5th–6th), until dispelled (7th+).

data.name: Blade of Disaster
data.description: Create a 3-ft blade-rift; immediately make up to two melee spell attacks vs creatures/objects within 5 ft. On a hit, 10d6 force. Crits on a d20 of 18+. As a bonus action later, move the rift up to 60 ft and repeat the two attacks. The blade passes harmlessly through any barrier (incl. Wall of Force).

data.name: Blinding Radiance
data.description: You emit bright light (50 ft) + dim (50 ft). A creature moving within 10 ft first time on its turn or starting there: CON save, 3d10 radiant + blinded until start of next turn (half, no blind on success).
data.higher_levels: +1d10 per slot above 4th.

data.name: Blood Rush
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Bloodbane Rune
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Boil Blood
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Bone Cage
data.description: Draw bones from corpses in range for temp HP by corpse size: Small 1d6+1; Medium 1d8+2; Large 1d10+5; Huge 1d12+12; Gargantuan 1d20+25. As an action, erupt the armour: expend all remaining temp HP; each other creature in range makes a DEX save, taking piercing = expended temp HP (half on success). However the temp HP is lost, the bones shatter and can't be reused.
data.higher_levels: Radius +10 ft per slot above 5th.

data.name: Cacophonic Shield
data.description: 10-ft Emanation. When it enters a creature's space or a creature enters/ends its turn there, CON save (once per turn), 3d6 thunder + deafened until start of your next turn (half on success). You have resistance to thunder; ranged attacks vs you have disadvantage. Designate unaffected creatures at cast.
data.higher_levels: +1d6 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Calling Card
data.description: Touch a corpse and leave a magical mark (visible rune/word, or Invisible). A creature taking the Study action to examine the corpse auto-detects it.

data.name: Can't Trip
data.description:
Choose a willing creature within range that you can see. Until the end of your next turn, that creature is immune to the prone condition. If it is already prone and is not restrained, this spell sets it on its feet.

The number of creatures you can simultaneously target increases by 1 at 5th level (2), 11th level (3), and 17th level (4).

data.name: Can'trip
data.description:
You temporarily tangle the Weave around a creature within range that you can see. Until the start of your next turn, each time the creature tries to cast a cantrip while this spell affects it, it must succeed on a spellcasting ability check against your spell save DC or waste its action (but not a spell slot). Ends if the target moves out of range.

Max level of spell inhibited increases at 5th level (1st-level), 11th level (2nd-level), and 17th level (3rd-level).

data.name: Cannotrip
data.description: Choose a creature within range. Each time it tries to cast a spell of equal or lower level than this spell, it must succeed on a spellcasting ability check against your spell save DC or waste its action (but not its spell slot).
data.higher_levels: Inhibit spells 1 level higher for each slot above 1st.

data.name: Chameleon Skin
data.description: A creature you touch (and its gear) shifts hues to match surroundings. It can take the Hide action as a bonus action each turn, even when only lightly obscured. If it didn't move last turn, creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to see it; creatures that don't rely on sight are immune.
data.higher_levels: One additional creature per slot above 1st.

data.name: Clue
data.description: All footprints/fingerprints in a 30-ft Emanation glow for the duration. Choose a point in time up to 10 days ago; only prints left since then highlight. Each creature gets a unique colour (not otherwise identified). New movement/touches leave prints too, possibly revealing invisible creatures.

data.name: Concussion
data.description:
With a thdoom heard 100 feet away, you cause a sudden increase in air pressure around a creature within range. CON save or take 1d8 thunder damage and become deafened until the start of your next turn.

Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th (2d8), 11th (3d8), and 17th (4d8) level.

data.name: Concussive Burst
data.description: 20-ft-radius sphere. CON save, 2d4 force + deafened until end of your next turn (half, no deafen on success).
data.higher_levels: +2d4 per slot above 1st.

data.name: Conjure Anomaly
data.description: Summon a random aberration (CR 5 or lower, GM's choice). Friendly for the duration; rolls initiative; obeys verbal commands (no action). If concentration breaks, you lose control and it turns hostile; it can't be dismissed and vanishes 1 hour after summoning.
data.higher_levels: CR +1 per slot above 5th.

data.name: Conjure Constructs
data.description:
Conjure construct spirits in range. On cast and as a Magic action later, command them vs a creature/object within 5 ft:

Clockwork Force. DEX save, 3d6 force (half on success).
Orderly Ward. Target gains 1d6 + spellcasting mod temp HP.

Move the spirits up to 30 ft when you move.
data.higher_levels: Damage and temp HP +1d6 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Consumption
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Corrupting Ichor
data.description: Ranged spell attack; on a hit, 2d8 necrotic damage. Until it uses its action to wipe off the phlegm, it takes 1d4 necrotic damage at the start of each turn and halves hit points regained.
data.higher_levels: Start-of-turn damage increases by 1d4 per slot above 1st.

data.name: Creeping Touch
data.description: Detach your hand into a Spider. Within 100 ft you can communicate telepathically; as a Magic action, see/hear through it until start of your next turn (you're Deaf/Blind in your own body meanwhile). If the spider dies or doesn't return before the spell ends, your hand restores but you take 1d6 psychic. Bonus action to recall it; on return it reattaches and the spell ends.

data.name: Crimson Lash
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Daydream
data.description: Float distracting thoughts into a humanoid's mind. WIS save or have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks (–5 to passive Perception) for the duration. A creature immune to charm is unaffected. Success by 5+ reveals the attempt.
data.higher_levels: One additional creature, or +30 ft range, per slot above 1st.

data.name: Death Armor
data.description: Target has advantage on Death Saving Throws; once per turn, a creature within 5 ft that hits it with a melee attack takes 2d4 necrotic.

data.name: Defenestration
data.description: A wave of force hurls a creature through a window. STR save. Fail: pushed up to 20 ft and thrown through a window of your choice (if none within 20 ft, a window of arcane force materializes); 4d6 slashing + prone. Success: pushed 10 ft, no damage.
data.higher_levels: +1d6 damage and +5 ft push per slot above 2nd.

data.name: Delay
data.description: WIS save or be moved to last in the Initiative order from the start of the next round.

data.name: Deryan's Helpful Homunculi
data.description: Intangible, invulnerable construct spirits with Arcana proficiency and the tools used. If crafting, they act as a single assistant, halving crafting time.

data.name: Dire Warning
data.description: Receive a ≤6-word message from your future self (GM determines). Later, once you've learned why, you must perform a 10-minute ritual (during a rest) to send it back. No message received = you'll never complete the ritual (death or hindrance). Can't recast for 7 days or until you perform its ritual.

data.name: Dirge
data.description:
60-ft Emanation. Designated creatures unaffected; others can't regain HP inside. When it enters a creature's space or a creature enters/ends its turn there (once per turn): CON save, 3d10 necrotic + prone (half + speed halved on success). A failed save also grants 1 Exhaustion; while exhausted, a Long Rest neither restores lost HP nor reduces exhaustion.

Circle Spell: ≥2 secondary casters; duration becomes Concentration up to 10 min. Each secondary caster expends a 4th+ slot.

data.name: Doomtide
data.description:
20-ft-radius sphere of magical Darkness. On appearance (and when it moves into a creature's space, a creature enters, or ends its turn there — once per turn): WIS save, 5d6 psychic and −1d6 to saves until end of next turn (half on success). Sphere moves 10 ft away from you each turn.

Circle Spell: ≥5 secondary casters; special component (three black pearls from Pandemonium, consumed); range 1 mile, duration until dispelled (no concentration). Each secondary caster expends a 3rd+ slot.

data.name: Eelskin
data.description:
A willing creature's skin produces electrified mucous; its unarmed strikes/natural weapons become magical. The first hit each turn deals +1d8 lightning damage.

Slimy. Advantage on checks/saves vs being grappled or restrained; disadvantage on its own grapple attempts.
data.higher_levels: Damage +1d8 per two slots above 2nd.

data.name: Elminster's Effulgent Epuration
data.description:
Six chromatic spheres orbit you. Expend spheres for:

Absorb Energy (Reaction). When you take Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder damage, expend one sphere for resistance to that type until start of your next turn.

Energy Blast (Bonus Action). Hurl a sphere at a target within 120 ft; ranged spell attack, 3d6 of your chosen type (sphere expended hit or miss).

Ends when no spheres remain.
data.higher_levels: +1 sphere per slot above 6th.

data.name: Elminster's Elusion
data.description: Advantage on saves vs spells and magical effects. If you succeed on such a save and would take half damage, you instead take none.

data.name: Endure
data.description: A willing creature ignores exhaustion and the poisoned condition; can't be incapacitated, stunned, paralysed, or knocked unconscious; needs no food/water. When it would drop to 0 HP it makes a death save instead; 3 failures = death. When the spell ends it gains a level of exhaustion per failed death save. If resurrected after dying this way, it stays unconscious for as long as the spell ran, then wakes with 3 exhaustion. If alive at the end, it falls unconscious for as long as the spell ran (only wish wakes it).
data.higher_levels: Duration up to 10 min (6th), 1 hr (7th), 8 hr (8th), 1 day (9th).

data.name: Enrage
data.description: Each humanoid in a 20-ft-radius sphere makes a CHA save (may choose to fail) or becomes enraged: hostile to all creatures; if concentrating, DC 10 CON save each turn or lose concentration. As an action, force an enraged creature to use its reaction to make one melee attack vs a random creature in reach. If it was friendly to that target, it can re-save after. Can re-save when it takes damage.
data.higher_levels: Force one additional enraged creature to attack per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Feverskin
data.description: Melee spell attack; on a hit, 6d6 fire. Repeatable as an action each turn. For the duration, +15 ft walking speed and 2d6 temp HP at the start of each of your turns.
data.higher_levels: +1d6 per slot above 5th.

data.name: Ferocious Strike
data.description:
With a pulse of adrenaline, make one weapon attack against a target within reach or range. On a hit, the target takes an additional 1d4 damage of the weapon's damage type.

Damage increases by 1d4 at 5th (2d4), 11th (3d4), and 17th (4d4) level.

data.name: Finger Guns
data.description:
Your hand becomes a Simple Ranged weapon (range 60/240, Slow mastery); use your spellcasting ability for attacks. On a hit, 2d6 force (no ability mod to damage).

Cantrip Upgrade: Range increases at levels 5 (90/360), 11 (120/480), 17 (150/600).

data.name: Firther's Shadow
data.description: INT save or take 4d10 psychic damage and you learn something (roll d6): 1 name; 2 a fear; 3 a desire; 4 condition immunities; 5 damage vuln/res/imm; 6 skill & save proficiencies. INT 4 or lower auto-succeeds. If it failed the first save, each turn you can action to force another INT save: fail = 4d6 psychic + you learn another thing; success = half damage, learn nothing, spell ends. Ends if target leaves range.
data.higher_levels: Initial/ongoing damage +1d10/+1d6 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Fixit
data.description: Imbue a broken item (no larger than 20 ft in any dimension) with belief; it's whole for the duration. If you knew its magical function (GM's discretion) and its rarity was common or lower, it regains magic for the duration.
data.higher_levels: Magical-restore rarity rises: uncommon (3rd), rare (5th), very rare (7th), legendary (9th).

data.name: Flare
data.description:
Ranged spell attack; on a hit, 1d8 radiant damage. On a critical hit, the target is covered in glittering light, granting advantage on attack rolls against it until the end of your next turn.

Alternatively, launch the pulse at a point in the air; until the end of your next turn it sheds bright light in a 20-ft radius and dim light for an additional 20 ft.

Damage and light radius increase at 5th (2d8, 30 ft), 11th (3d8, 40 ft), and 17th (4d8, 50 ft) level.

data.name: Flipperform
data.description: A willing creature grows webbed fingers and gains a swimming speed equal to its walking speed.
data.higher_levels: One additional creature per slot above 1st; duration doubles per slot above 1st.

data.name: Food Coma
data.description: A willing creature that eats the enchanted drumstick falls unconscious for 1 hour. Woken only by damage or greater restoration/wish. At the hour's end it wakes refreshed with full HP. Woken early = spell ends with no effect (and they're grumpy).
data.higher_levels: One additional drumstick/creature per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Force Blast
data.description:
Ranged spell attack vs a creature or object; on a hit, 1d8 force.

Cantrip Upgrade: +1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), 17 (4d8).

data.name: Frightful Start
data.description: WIS save or Frightened until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Frogskin
data.description:
Morph into a poisonous frog. Melee spell attack; on a hit, 3d10 poison + poisoned until end of your next turn. Repeatable as an action each turn.

Slimy. Advantage on checks/saves vs grapple/restrain; disadvantage on your own grapples. Anyone grappling you (or grappled by you) makes a CON save at start of its turn: 3d10 poison (half on success).
data.higher_levels: Both damages +1d10 per slot above 4th.

data.name: Fungal Infection
data.description:
15-ft-radius sphere. CON save or cursed until spell ends. Choose one fungus at cast:

  • Amanita Rotgut. 2d6 poison + poisoned; 2d6 poison at end of each turn.
  • Necrotising Zygomycosis. 2d8 necrotic; 2d8 necrotic at start of each turn.
  • Psilocybin Quickitrippiae. 'Tripping': d4 at start of turn; on a 1, no move/actions.
  • Paralysing Mucorales. At end of each turn, stunned until start of next turn; fail by 5+ → paralysed instead.
  • Raging Henbane. Charmed by you; reaction each turn to attack a random creature in reach (not you).
  • Veiled Lady. Pinhole vision: disadvantage on DEX saves; ranged attacks have advantage vs it.

Re-saves each turn (after the effect triggers) to end.
data.higher_levels: Amanita/Necrotising damage +1d6/+1d8 per slot above 4th. At 6th+, choose two fungi.

data.name: Game of Fate
data.description: Compel a creature that can hear/understand you into a nonmagical game (unwilling: WIS save or compelled). Loser takes 6d6 psychic; if no result by the end, both take it. Harming the target forfeits the game (and vice versa). You can negotiate stakes: higher psychic (max 12d6), currency, property, or esoteric rewards (e.g. a title); the spell reveals unfulfillable bets. Property/currency teleports to the winner; the loser is compelled to fulfill wagered actions. No outside force can influence the outcome.

data.name: Ghost Light
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Gravity Repulsion
data.description:
Ranged weapon attacks vs you have disadvantage; area within 20 ft is difficult terrain for chosen creatures you can see.

Gravity Pulse. On cast and as a bonus action later, force one Huge or smaller creature within 20 ft to STR save or be pushed 10 ft, knocked prone, and take 3d6 force damage.
data.higher_levels: Difficult-terrain radius +5 ft; pulse damage/range +1d6/+5 ft per slot above 4th.

data.name: Gravity Smash
data.description: 40-ft-radius, 100-ft-high cylinder becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn, then gravity smashes downward. STR save: if the spell ran its full duration, 8d10 force + prone on a fail; if ended early, 4d10 on a fail. Half and no prone on success.
data.higher_levels: Both damage values +1d10 per slot above 5th.

data.name: Hangover
data.description: CON save, 3d8 psychic + poisoned until end of your next turn (half on success). The damage gives disadvantage on CON saves to maintain Concentration.
data.higher_levels: +1d8 per slot above 2nd.

data.name: Holy Star of Mystra
data.description: A glowing mote hovers above you (bright 5 ft / dim 5 ft). On cast and as a bonus action later, fire a bolt at a target within 120 ft; ranged spell attack, 4d10 + spellcasting mod Force or Radiant. You have Three-Quarters Cover; if you succeed on a save vs a level-7-or-lower single-target, non-AoE spell, you can Reaction-deflect it back at the caster (using their DC).

data.name: Holy Word
data.description:
Ranged spell attack; on a hit, 1d8 radiant. If the target is a Fey, Fiend, or Undead, its speed is reduced by 10 ft and it can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn.

Cantrip Upgrade: +1d8 at levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), 17 (4d8).

data.name: Homunculus Servant
data.description:
Summon a homunculus (uses the Homunculus Servant stat block). Replaces any prior one. You set its appearance.

Combat. Ally; shares your initiative, acts immediately after you; obeys commands (no action). Otherwise Dodges and avoids danger.

Higher-Level Slot: Use the slot's level as the spell's level in the stat block.

data.name: Howl
data.description: You utter a magically-augmented howl heard for 1,000 feet, manifesting as any animal call you've heard. Choose one familiar creature as recipient: if it can hear the howl, it understands your meaning and can respond in kind. Creatures under comprehend languages or that understand beasts can also understand it; otherwise it's unintelligible.

data.name: Humperdink's Halitosis
data.description: Belch acidic fumes in a 15-ft cone (spreads around corners). CON save, 3d4 acid (half on success). Fumes linger until end of your next turn or dispersed by moderate+ wind; creatures ending their turn in the area make a CON save for 3d4 acid (half on success).
data.higher_levels: Damage (both) increases by 1d4 per slot above 1st.

data.name: Hunter Sense
data.description: Touch a willing creature; whenever it makes a Wisdom (Perception) check, it can treat a d20 of 9 or lower as a 10.

data.name: Illusory Instrument
data.description: Create an illusory mundane instrument (tangible only to you, usable as a Spellcasting Focus; dissipates if you move 10 ft away or end the spell). As a bonus action, command it to: mimic basic daily sounds; play a basic beat; record/loop what's played on it; or record/playback any noise within 15 ft.

data.name: Incorporeality
data.description: A willing creature (and its gear) becomes translucent. At the start of each of its turns it can choose to become incorporeal (no action) until end of turn: advantage on Stealth; resistance to nonmagical b/p/s; can move through creatures/objects as difficult terrain. Ending a turn inside an object → shunted to nearest free space, 1d10 force per 5 ft shunted.
data.higher_levels: Increase duration — 10 min (6th), 1 hr (7th), 8 hr (8th), 24 hr (9th) — OR +1 target per slot.

data.name: Inequality
data.description:
Twist the fates of two creatures in range; choose one to favour, one to disfavour. The disfavoured makes a CHA save or:

  • Favoured adds 1d4 to its attack rolls and saves.
  • Disfavoured subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saves.
  • Disfavoured's speed is halved; favoured's increases by half.

Ends for the pair if either is downed/killed or the spell ends. Favoured can't benefit from bless; disfavoured can't be afflicted by bane.
data.higher_levels: Link two more creatures per two slots above 2nd.

data.name: Influenza
data.description: 30-ft cone (sneeze heard 300 ft). DEX save, 3d6 poison + poisoned (half, no poison on success). Poisoned creature re-saves (CON) each turn. While poisoned, roll d12 at start of turn; on 3 or lower it's incapacitated until start of next turn, and each creature within 5 ft must CON save or also become poisoned this way.
data.higher_levels: +1d6 damage and +1 to the d12 threshold per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Initiative
data.description: As a reaction when initiative is rolled, choose a willing creature. If surprised, it is no longer surprised and takes its turn round one as normal. If not surprised, it gains advantage on the triggering initiative roll.
data.higher_levels: One additional creature per slot above 1st.

data.name: Intaglio
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Laeral's Silver Lance
data.description: 120-ft-long, 5-ft-wide line. Each chosen creature makes a STR save, 3d10 force + prone (half, no prone on success).
data.higher_levels: +1d10 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Lungburst
data.description: CON save (disadvantage if holding breath). Fail: 7d6 thunder + 7d6 necrotic and begins suffocating. Success: half, no suffocation. Suffocating creature re-saves each turn to end it. Creatures that don't breathe are immune. Greater restoration, heal, or wish restores breathing.
data.higher_levels: Both damages +1d6 per slot above 6th.

data.name: Magecraft
data.description: Choose an Artisan's Tool or Herbalism Kit; add 1d6 to ability checks for the Utilize action with that tool for the duration.

data.name: Magnetite Shard
data.description: 20-ft-radius sphere. DEX save, 4d6 cold + 3d6 piercing (half on success). Ferrous-material/armour creatures have disadvantage.
data.higher_levels: +1d6 cold per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Magnetobolt
data.description:
Ranged spell attack of arcanomagnetic energy. On a hit, 1d6 force damage and STR save or knocked prone. Creatures made of ferrous metal or wearing ferrous armour have disadvantage on the save.

Damage increases by 1d6 at 5th (2d6), 11th (3d6), and 17th (4d6) level.

data.name: Mandy's Feral Follower
data.description:
Touch a Medium or smaller Beast; it becomes a Humanoid (your choice of appearance) using the Commoner stat block but keeping its HP/Hit Dice. You choose its skill proficiency; it wears Fine Clothes. Gains 10 temp HP (ends if none left; clothes vanish into smoke). Acts as a dutifully employed ally on its own initiative.

Duration: In normal-time locations, lasts until the twelfth stroke of the next midnight; elsewhere, 24 hours.
data.higher_levels: One additional Beast per slot above 4th.

data.name: Mass Leech
data.description: Each creature of your choice within 20 ft makes a CON save, 2d8 necrotic (half on success). You regain HP equal to half the total necrotic dealt to Small or larger creatures.
data.higher_levels: +1d8 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Mechamagic
data.description:
Instill an item with belief, granting a property by type:

  • Armour. Wearer gains 1d4 temp HP at start of each turn.
  • Belt. Flying speed 30 ft.
  • Boots. +10 ft walking speed; jump distance tripled.
  • Cloak. Advantage on Stealth to hide; can hide while only lightly obscured.
  • Gloves. Climb speed = walking speed (incl. ceilings) without checks; advantage on grapple-related checks.
  • Headwear. No need to breathe; advantage vs poisoned; resistance to poison.

End early by touching the item; ends if recast.
data.higher_levels: One additional item per slot above 4th.

data.name: Memorize
data.description: Your eyes pass over a page of text, committing it to memory. For 1 year you remember exact details; after that, advantage on INT checks to recall it.

data.name: Mireball
data.description: 15-ft-radius sphere. STR save, 3d10 bludgeoning + knocked prone (half, no prone on success). Surfaces become slick/sticky mud for the duration: first time a creature moves through on its turn, DEX save or fall prone (moving at half speed avoids the save).
data.higher_levels: +1d10 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Moment to Think
data.description: Briefly stop time for everyone but you. Take one additional action — only Search, Study, or Utilize — and move in your space. You can't affect/damage anything but what you wear/carry; dropped objects freeze in time.

data.name: Mortiferous Pulse
data.description: 5-ft-wide, 50-ft-long line. DEX save, 3d8 necrotic (half on success).
data.higher_levels: +1d8 per slot above 2nd.

data.name: Neutralize Aura
data.description: A willing creature can't be perceived by Fey, Fiends, Celestials, or Undead. Ends early if the target attacks, deals damage, casts a spell, or moves within 5 ft of one of those creature types.
data.higher_levels: One additional creature per slot above 1st.

data.name: Paradox
data.description: Undo one action taken within range in the last round. Direct effects (damage from an attack/spell) are undone; indirect effects (movement choices) are not. The creature that took the action takes 10d8 psychic as its history is modified.

data.name: Peppermint Plate
data.description: A layer of hard peppermint icing coats you: +1 AC, and a creature hitting you with a melee attack takes 1d4 fire damage (once per turn max).
data.higher_levels: Fire damage increases by 1d4 per slot above 1st.

data.name: Pins & Needles
data.description:
CON save or take 1d8 psychic damage. If the target fails by 5 or more, it has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

Damage increases by 1d8 at 5th (2d8), 11th (3d8), and 17th (4d8) level.

data.name: Polybrachia
data.description: Two arcane arms appear on a willing creature: wield weapons/shields (up to 2 two-handed or 4 one-handed weapons simultaneously), do somatic components, and other actions. Advantage on Strength (Athletics). Bonus action to make a melee attack with a weapon the arms wield.

data.name: Power Word Shield
data.description: A translucent shield bubbles out from a creature. Until the end of its next turn it is immune to all damage except psychic, has advantage on all saves, and other power word spells have no effect on it. Removes poisoned and extinguishes flames.
data.casting_time: 1 Reaction (when a creature you can see is targeted by an attack or spell)

data.name: Preserve (Abjuration)
data.description: Each creature in a 10-ft-radius sphere makes a CHA save or becomes soulbound for the duration. If it dies while soulbound, its magic is bound to its components for 24 hours, allowing harvesting. Once harvesting starts, the spell ends for that corpse. Creatures with robust+ essence (typically CR 7+) auto-succeed.
data.higher_levels: Auto-success essence tier rises per two slots above 2nd — potent/CR 12+ (4th), mythic/CR 18+ (6th), deific/CR 25+ (8th).

data.name: Preserve (Transmutation)
data.description: Food/perishables ≤5 lb placed in a sack don't age or decay for the duration.

data.name: Primal Scent
data.description:
You magically enhance surrounding scents. You have advantage on the next ability check relying on smell, and can treat a roll of 4 or lower as a 5.

At higher levels, smell-based checks can treat a roll of 7 or lower as 8 (5th), 10 or lower as 11 (11th), and 13 or lower as 14 (17th).

data.name: Protection
data.description: A warding sigil circles a willing creature for an hour. Immediately before it next takes damage (except psychic), the ward triggers: until the end of its next turn it has resistance to all damage except psychic (including the triggering damage). Then the spell ends.
data.higher_levels: One additional creature per slot above 2nd.

data.name: Recall
data.description: Record your location. Until end of next turn, Reaction (vs an attack roll, a creature casting a spell, or a creature moving within 5 ft) to teleport back to that location (or nearest free space), before the triggering attack/spell. Then ends.

data.name: Rumor
data.description: Spread a rumor of ≤10 words in a 100-ft Emanation. Creatures that can hear/understand ≥3 others believe they hear it repeated nearby; origin is untraceable. Won't make creatures Hostile but can shift attitudes.

data.name: Shackles of Pain
data.description: Link a willing source to a target. Target makes a CHA save or is linked for 1 minute. Each time the source takes damage, the target takes psychic damage equal to half. If you're the source, the target takes this before your concentration save. Target re-saves whenever it takes this damage.

data.name: Shielding Word
data.description: A creature gains 15 temporary hit points the instant before it takes the triggering damage. Lasts until the start of its next turn.
data.higher_levels: Per slot above 2nd, either +30 ft range or +5 temp HP.

data.name: Shroud Blood
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Simbul's Synostodweomer
data.description: Whenever the target casts a spell using a slot, it can roll Hit Point Dice equal to the slot's level and regain that total + your spellcasting mod; those dice are expended.

data.name: Smokescreen
data.description:
You spew a 5-foot-diameter, 10-foot-high cylinder of dense black smoke centred on you that lasts until the start of your next turn and heavily obscures its area. Choose whether it stays put or moves with you.

Max diameter/height increases to 15 ft (5th), 25 ft (11th), 40 ft (17th).

data.name: Somnolence
data.description: [stub — full text not in source]

data.name: Songal's Elemental Infusion
data.description:
Elemental Immunity. Choose a type (Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder); resistance to it.

Elemental Pulse. On cast and start of each turn, 15-ft Emanation; each chosen creature makes a DEX save, 2d6 of your chosen type + prone (half, no prone on success).

Flight. Fly speed 30 ft, can hover.

Circle Spell: casting time 1 minute, duration Concentration up to 10 min; +1 chosen creature per secondary caster (max 9). Each secondary caster expends a 2nd+ slot.

data.name: Spark
data.description:
Ranged spell attack; on a hit, 1d8 lightning damage. On a critical hit, the target is also blinded until the end of its next turn.

Creates more sparks at higher levels: two (5th), three (11th), four (17th). Separate attack roll each.

data.name: Spellfire Flare
data.description: Ranged spell attack; target gains no benefit from Half/Three-Quarters Cover. On a hit, 2d10 radiant.
data.higher_levels: One additional blast per slot above 1st.

data.name: Spellfire Storm
data.description:
20-ft-radius, 20-ft-high cylinder of bright light. On appearance / entering / ending turn (once per turn): CON save, 4d10 radiant (half on success). A creature casting a spell inside makes a CON save or the spell dissipates (action/slot still spent unless... slot isn't expended). Designate unaffected creatures at cast.

Circle Spell: special component (blue star sapphire worth 25,000+ gp, consumed); range 1 mile, no concentration. Each secondary caster expends a 3rd+ slot.

Secondary CastersAreaDuration
1–340-ft radius, 40-ft high cylinder1 Hour
4–660-ft radius, 60-ft high cylinder8 Hours
7+100-ft radius, 100-ft high cylinder24 Hours
data.higher_levels: +1d10 per slot above 4th.

data.name: Spore Cloud
data.description:
Each creature within 5 ft (other than you) makes a CON save or takes 1d4 poison damage. A creature that fails by 5+ is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

Damage increases by 1d4 at 5th (2d4), 11th (3d4), 17th (4d4) level.

data.name: Stalker's Eye
data.description:
A willing creature you touch gains a sense for weaknesses. The first time it makes an attack under this spell, it makes the attack with advantage; then the spell ends.

The augmented attack crits on 19–20 (5th), 18–20 (11th), 17–20 (17th).

data.name: Stench
data.description: 20-ft-radius sphere of choking fumes. On entering first time on its turn or starting its turn there, CON save, 3d6 poison + poisoned until end of next turn (half, no poison on success). While poisoned this way, disadvantage on concentration saves.
data.higher_levels: +1d6 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Sugar Rush
data.description: A willing creature gains +15 ft speed and +1 AC, and can Dash/Disengage/Hide/Use an Object as a bonus action each turn. When the spell ends — or if it doesn't move up to its walking speed by the end of its turn — it gets a stomach ache and is poisoned until the end of its next turn.
data.higher_levels: One additional creature per slot above 2nd.

data.name: Swarm
data.description:
A cloud of poisonous spiders floats toward a target. DEX save or become poisoned until the end of its next turn.

Deals poison damage on a failed save at higher levels: 1d10 (5th), 2d10 (11th), 3d10 (17th).

data.name: Switcheroo
data.description: Attempt to switch places with a Large or smaller target you can see. CHA save or teleport-swap positions. Auto-succeeds if there's not enough space; willing creatures may choose to fail.
data.higher_levels: Range +30 ft per slot above 3rd. Max target size: Huge (6th+), Gargantuan (9th).

data.name: Syluné's Viper
data.description: Gain 15 temp HP (spell ends if none left). Climbing: climb speed = speed. Venomous Bite (Magic action): ranged spell attack within 50 ft, 1d6 force + poisoned until start of your next turn; while poisoned, it's incapacitated.
data.higher_levels: +5 temp HP and Venomous Bite +1d6 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Tentacle Lash
data.description: One arm becomes a tentacle. On cast and as an action each turn, melee spell attack within 30 ft: 5d8 bludgeoning, and if Huge or smaller, STR save or choose one — prone; shoved 5 ft; or disarm (you take and keep one held item). The tentacle can also work like a grappling hook/rope (GM's discretion).
data.higher_levels: +1d8 per slot above 4th.

data.name: The Bends
data.description: CON save, 5d8 poison + poisoned for 1 minute (half, no poison on success). If fully submerged in water, dice become d10s. Re-saves each turn to end.
data.higher_levels: +1d8 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Totem Arrows
data.description:
Imbue a quiver's ammunition with a spirit; creatures hit (or targeted, for Hawk) are subject to the current spirit. Bonus action to change spirit:

  • Cat. +1d6 slashing (2d6 if the attack had advantage).
  • Elk. +1d6 bludgeoning; STR save or prone/shoved 5 ft.
  • Hawk. Ignores half and three-quarters cover.
  • Hogweed. CON save or blinded until end of next turn.
  • Psilocybin. WIS save or 'tripping' for the duration (d4 each turn; on a 1, incapacitated and effect ends).
  • Roc. STR save or speed 0 and lifted 20 ft until end of next turn, then falls.
  • Snake. +1d6 poison; CON save or poisoned (re-saves to end).
  • Spider. DEX save or restrained until end of next turn (Athletics/Acrobatics action to end).
data.higher_levels: Duration becomes Concentration up to 8 hours.

data.name: Wardaway
data.description: CON save (Constructs/Undead auto-succeed). Fail: 2d4 force, speed halved until start of your next turn, and next turn it can take only an action OR a bonus action (not both). Half on success.
data.higher_levels: +2d4 per slot above 1st.

data.name: Weave Entanglement
data.description:
20-ft-radius sphere. Whenever a creature casts a 1st-level+ spell in the area, it makes a spellcasting-ability check vs your DC; on a failure the spell casts AND produces an extra effect (roll d10): 1 gravity smash · 2 phantasmal killer · 3 confusion · 4 fireball · 5 zippit! · 6 web · 7 darkness · 8 silence · 9 regain 2d10 HP · 10 spell cast without expending a slot.

The extra spell targets/centres on the caster (no control); save DCs equal the caster's DC; concentration spells need no concentration. At initiative count 20 each round, roll d20 per ongoing effect; on 11+ it ends.
data.higher_levels: Radius +10 ft per slot above 6th.

data.name: Weavebend
data.description: Redirect a spell. If 3rd level or lower, redirect automatically; if 4th+, make a spellcasting-ability check (DC 10 + spell's level). Ranged spell attack → retarget within 10 ft of original; AoE → shift up to 10 ft.
data.casting_time: 1 Reaction (when you see a creature within range cast a spell)
data.higher_levels: Auto-redirect if the spell's level is less than your slot's level.

data.name: Zippit!
data.description: In response to a creature vocalizing, CON save or be silenced (mouth fused) for the duration. Silencing a verbal-component caster wastes its action but not its slot. At end of each turn the target can STR save to tear its mouth open: 1d8 slashing and silence ends. Or, as an action, cut it open with a blade for the same.
data.casting_time: 1 Reaction (when a creature within range vocalises)
data.higher_levels: +1d8 per slot above 3rd.

data.name: Homunculus Servant

scaling.notes: HP = 5 + 5 per spell level; Hit Dice [d4s] = spell's level; PB = your PB

traits.name: Evasion
traits.text: On a successful DEX save for half, takes none; on a failure, half. Can't use while Incapacitated.

traits.name: Magic Bond
traits.text: Add the spell's level to any ability check or save it makes.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack: your spell attack mod, reach 5 ft or range 30 ft. Hit: 1d6 + spell's level force damage.

reactions.name: Channel Magic
reactions.text: When you cast a touch-range spell while it's within 120 ft, it delivers the spell through its touch.

data.description: Summon a homunculus. Replaces any prior one. You set its appearance. Ally; shares your initiative, acts immediately after you; obeys commands (no action). Otherwise Dodges and avoids danger.
